scenes.headline: How a 1T model learns from reward alone
scenes.sub: Ring-Zero: zero RL on Ling-2.5-1T-Base, 63B active.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Snowdrop! Ring-Zero trains a one-trillion-parameter base model to reason with nothing but a checkable reward. No human-written reasoning at all.

scenes.text: Reward only a right answer and clean format, at trillion scale, and keep training stable with a four-stage pipeline and one ratio fix.
scenes.say: The idea: reward only a right answer and a clean format, at trillion scale, and keep it stable with four stages and one ratio fix.

scenes.title: Four stages, each fixing the last

items.say: Stage one's loss isn't divided by length, so longer correct traces earn more credit. The model learns to think at length, and to pad.
Self-distillation keeps the shortest correct traces, trims the bloat, and resets the gap between the training and inference engines.
Stage two divides the loss by length, so rambling earns nothing.
Stage three trains three tiers, so one checkpoint reasons short or long on demand.

scenes.title: The quiet fix
scenes.say: One engine writes the rollouts, another trains on them, and they disagree by tiny amounts.

parts.note: what the inference engine assigned when it wrote the rollout
parts.say: Below the line: what the inference engine gave the token when it wrote it.

parts.note: what the training engine assigns now
parts.say: Above it: what the training engine assigns now. So the ratio measures the update actually made.
In the ablations, a naive ratio collapsed near step eight hundred. This one kept training.

scenes.title: AIME 2024 after stage-one RL
scenes.note: the full pipeline still trails frontier models
scenes.say: Scale moves the ceiling. After stage one, the trillion-parameter model scores eighty-nine point one on AIME. The smaller flash model, seventy-one point two.

scenes.text: Zero RL sharpens the reasoning already latent in pretraining. A bigger base, not a cleverer reward, moves the ceiling.

recap: Reward: a right answer plus clean format
The ratio uses the training engine's probability
scenes.say: To recap: a checkable reward, four stages that grow then trim the reasoning, and a ratio that keeps the engines honest.
